Click it for the m"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"odel, input/output/cache tokens, model-call count, rate window, and session total—without opening an"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"other panel or repeating the composer's existing token and cache readings."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Pricing and totals stay under your control"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Edit model rates, add custom models, apply the official peak/off-peak schedule, inspect per-model to"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tals, and export or import the configuration from **Settings → Cost Guard**."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> The screenshots were captured from an earlier v4.3 instance and still show the old full-width bar."},{"id":"p13s2","text":" Release `v5.1.0` uses the compact pill and the 2026-10-28 official rates described below; the image"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s will be refreshed after the next capture."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Why Cost Guard"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Actual usage, not prompt-size guessing** — reads `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"`, and `cacheWriteTokens` from DSH session events, including retried or interrupted attempts.
- **Li"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ve and glanceable** — keeps the current task cost beside the composer; click for the token mix and s"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ession total.
- **Subagent-aware** — rolls subagent usage into the active root-session turn, priced "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"with the model that actually served each call.
- **Restart-resilient** — rebuilds a session from its"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" persisted log the first time it is viewed, so history survives plugin restarts.
- **Pricing you can"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" audit** — all model rates and the peak/off-peak windows are visible and editable.
- **Bilingual UI*"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"* — the pill and settings page follow the DSH language setting (中文 / English) automatically.
- **Loc"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"al-only** — no telemetry, external service, account access, or API key collection.
- **Zero executio"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"n interference** — no prediction gate, approval overlay, or model routing."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Install into your current profile"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`dsh-cost-guard` is a Cordis **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (the Host row) a"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nd `dsh.client` (the browser half). Install it the way DSH installs any bundle:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. Put this repository somewhere stable on disk, for example `D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard`.
2. Restart DSH when the installer reports `restart-required`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Ask your DSH agent instead, if you prefer:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The plugin then appears as **Cost Guard** in the plugin inventory and as a top-level **Settings → Co"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"st Guard** page, with a compact cost pill below the composer. No build step is required: both halves"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" are plain JavaScript."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"For local development against a checkout, the same command accepts the checkout path directly and li"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"nks it instead of copying it."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1+` (Desktop or `dsh web`), with a profile that includes the Web app bundle."},{"id":"p27s2","text":"
- DSH Web UI for the pill and settings panel.
- Node.js is only needed to run `npm run check` durin"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"for the pill and settings panel.
- Node.js is only needed to run `npm run check` during development."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Pricing model"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The `v5.1.0` defaults match the official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / V4 Pro peak/off-peak pricing verified"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" on **2026-10-28** against the DeepSeek API pricing page and the 2026-09-10 price update. Rates are "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"CNY per 1M tokens, off-peak (valley) prices:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **Host half** (`index.js`) injects `webServer`, folds durable session events, attributes usage to "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"turns, rolls up subagents, backfills a session from its log on first look, and serves two data route"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"s plus a health probe.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) is a `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle that re"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"gisters the cost pill in `conversation.composer.dock` and the configuration UI in `settings.section`"},{"id":"p33s5","text":", and reads the Host through `fetch`.
- **Data flow** stays inside the running DSH process; the rout"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"es are plain localhost HTTP with no network egress.
- **Pricing state** is persisted to `~/.dsh/cost"},{"id":"p33s7","text":"-guard/config.json` (`$DSH_HOME` aware), so rates survive restarts."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Security and privacy"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- No outbound requests, telemetry, credential reads, or API key storage.
- The Host observes DSH ses"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"sion usage events and replays persisted session events to reconstruct totals.
- Imported configurati"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"on is validated before it replaces the active settings.
- Review third-party plugin source before in"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"stalling it, especially because DSH plugin interfaces are still evolving."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for reporting guidance."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"This plugin depends on DSH services and UI slots (`webServer`, `sessions`, `session/event`, `convers"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ation.composer.dock`, `settings.section`). They are not guaranteed stable APIs. Include your DSH ver"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"sion when reporting compatibility problems."}],"truncated":true}
